resources.string: Allow microphone access in the phone app
Microphone will be available in the next recording

Audio: recording uses the phone microphone and is on by default. Live listening on the watch is a separate option, off by default; watch media volume controls playback. While recording, the camera switch becomes a microphone mute button, including during a pause. Muting records silence in this file and does not switch off live listening. Allow microphone access on the phone before recording. Without permission at the start, audio can only be added to the next recording. Leaving the watch app stops live listening; background recording follows the background setting. Use headphones to avoid feedback. Capture sounds are a separate setting.

Downloads continue after closing the gallery. A notification shows preparation or download progress and Cancel. The gallery marks queued, downloading and completed files. Cancelling removes the unfinished copy and keeps completed files. Allow notifications on the watch to see progress outside the app. Compression happens on the phone before download.
